newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar says to build England facility.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar says to build England facility.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Wednesday it will build a plant in England to manufacture steel track shoes for earthmoving equipment which the company builds in Europe. A spokeswoman declined to say what the company will spend on the plant.

The 46,500-sq.-ft. facility in Skinningrove, about 20 miles south of Middlesbrough, will initially employ about 35, the company said in a statement. It is slated to be in operation in late 1997, Caterpillar said.
Caterpillar had $16 billion in sales and revenues in 1995. It said it has five other manufacturing and distribution facilties in England.
